name: SQL Dojo
description: Practice the LeetCode SQL 50 inside DBX. Runs a real PostgreSQL 16 engine locally — no server, no setup, works offline. 50 questions with per-question hints and result-set based grading.
releaseNotes: LeetCode SQL 50 practice workbench backed by PostgreSQL 16 (PGlite, WebAssembly). Local-only: no database connection required. Question bank derived from the MIT-licensed Camio1945/leetcode-study-plan-top-sql-50 repository, converted to PostgreSQL and verified question by question.

zh-CN.name: SQL 练习场
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 里刷力扣 SQL 50 题。内置真正的 PostgreSQL 16 引擎，离线可用、无需配置数据库。每题带考察点标签和思路提示，按结果集判题。
